### Purpose

### Parameters
| Parameter        | Description                                                                 |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `Plan*`          | The plan node being executed                                                |
| `EState* estate`| Global execution state holding shared information during query execution   |
| `int instrument`| Boolean flag indicating whether performance information should be collected |

### Returns
A pointer to the newly allocated and set-up `PlanState`.

### Implementation
